image_description: A high-angle, close-up photograph of a metallic green tiger beetle (Cicindelidae) positioned on rough, dry soil. The beetle features a highly iridescent exoskeleton with distinct highlights, long slender legs, and prominent mandibles. The lighting is natural, casting sharp shadows beneath the body.
